findings.summary: The fragment says the head arm ran at 2640003b86, while after-suite.log's own header names revision 00645a9bd9758cef463748229bbdd35cfc72411a, so the citation cannot be reconciled with the log it points to; the measurement still stands because the two revisions differ only in this docs fragment.

The matched arms collect only the new test plus tests/test_staged_write_inventory.py and tests/test_every_shared_home_lock_holds_across_nodes.py, neither of which imports station_subscriber, while thirteen test files do, so the done_when clause that the importing test files add no failure against base is not demonstrated; the coordinator should widen the suite fence, since the node's own fence generated this command.

justifications.evidence: tests/test_a_tick_walks_the_process_table_once.py:304-310 asserts one walk and gate-tick-walk.log records 1 passed EXIT=0, but the matched arms in after-suite.log:5 cover none of the thirteen test files that import station_subscriber.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/station_subscriber.py:352 reuses the same region idiom already used at reckon/crew/obligation_snapshot.py:1631 and adds no plan or ticket name.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/station_subscriber.py:352-357 wraps the whole terminal-duty loop in process_signal.process_table_walk_once(), so the pass takes one table for every pointer it classifies.
justifications.reuse: The change calls the existing process_table_walk_once owner at reckon/crew/process_signal.py:309 rather than adding a second walk-sharing mechanism; no duplicate definition was found.
justifications.scope_discipline: Every path in git diff b8530ec5..00645a9b lies inside the manifest's declared write paths, and the docs commit 00645a9b touches only the fragment.

verdicts.diff: Read commit by commit: 441765e4 opens the existing walk region in station_subscriber.py, 2640003b repairs the test's assertion message and final newline, and 00645a9b adds the evidence fragment; no file outside the declared scope changed.
